hits.label: The Unicode Standard
hits.description: computing industry standard for the consistent encoding, representation and handling of text expressed in most of the world's writing systems

hits.label: UNICEF
hits.description: specialised agency of the United Nations

hits.label: Unicode character
hits.description: type of code point used to encode a character in the Universal Character Set (UCS) defined by the Unicode and ISO/IEC 10646 standards

hits.label: private-use character
hits.description: Unicode code point set to a character but left aside for private use
